diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts correctly identified the order sequence (Order K then Order L) based on shared public facts (S1, S3) to minimize setup loss, even though PF3 (which flips C1 and C5) was intended to reverse this sequence. The model is using a generic 'inimize setup loss' heuristic from the public information to make decisions that are structurally independent of the hidden information.
